scope: Owned-context deletion on the isolated development app; no release promotion.

behavior_contract.explicit_confirmation: Review the owned context and saved-work counts, then deliberately confirm permanent deletion; Cancel does not start it.
behavior_contract.stale_confirmation: The context version, head and preview digest must still match.
behavior_contract.pending_cleanup: Normal content access is fenced while deletion is pending; Retry deletion resumes recorded cleanup.
behavior_contract.removed_scope: The selected context's application rows, personal overlays and associated Select AI conversations captured in its cleanup manifest.
behavior_contract.preserved_scope: The public knowledge collection, independent copied contexts and other users' contexts.
behavior_contract.retained_receipts: Minimal identifier/count/status receipts remain; completed deletion removes the context title and cleanup manifest.
behavior_contract.retention_limit: This feature does not promise erasure of service/provider/administrator audit records or backups.
